About

Marketing graduate who started by founding a student community and kept going. Now studying Intercultural Business Communication at EMUNI, with events, partnerships and audiences across three languages behind me.

I founded and led GenC FSEGso, a student community for skill development and better campus life. I ran its social media strategy, organised workshops and managed the partnerships behind them.

Since 2022 I have worked on-site at Cuba In Tunisia, a week-long Cuban festival that runs around the clock, looking after international guests, artists and VIP attendees. I also manage social accounts as a freelance community manager and take part in European Solidarity Corps programmes.
